testReadPrefixes.note: Model.read(url) with no lang: Jena picks RDF/XML from '.rdf'. Even with a lang, @factoidal/core 0.16.0 parse() reports no prefixes for RDF/XML (Dataset.prefixes is {} for xmlns declarations).

testWritePrefixes.note: @factoidal/core 0.18.0 writes RDF/XML with its own ns1:, ns2: prefixes (WriteOptions.prefixes is Turtle-only) and its RDF/XML reader reports no xmlns prefixes (Dataset.prefixes is {}), so 'spoo' and 'fred' do not survive. Prefixes are not part of the RDF abstract syntax (RDF 1.1 Concepts section 3), so no specification is broken; danbri/factoidal#1088 item 4 asks for the options.
